name: E02_4_crossway_troublemakers_another_vampire_dies_pay_two_and_draw
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever a Vampire you control dies, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.' Seat 0's Vampire (not Troublemakers itself) is dealt lethal damage by seat 1's Ogre and dies. Seat 0 takes the may (fire): it pays 2 life (18) and draws a card (hand 0 -> 1). Troublemakers stays on the battlefield.
